completeness.why: Every month-wide action takes its selection (income outside tracking, hidden category, hidden group) from shouldFillCategory, with the preserved inconsistencies carried as explicit named options (includeHidden for setZero, requireGroup for the averages' missing-group skip); both average sign inversions (set3MonthAvg and setNMonthAvg) go through averageToBudgetAmount. Sites only pass their own rows and those options.

interface.why: shouldFillCategory takes the category plus two named options that correspond exactly to the existing variations (setZero writing hidden categories, averages skipping categories without a group), and averageToBudgetAmount takes just the average and income flag; no speculative options.
